Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

✅ Our commitment: ScrollLok does not collect, store, or share your personal data or your child's data with third parties. All schedule and blocking data stays entirely on your device.

1. Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how ScrollLok handles information when you use our parental control application. We are committed to protecting your privacy and your child's privacy.

2. Information We Do NOT Collect

🚫 We never collect any of the following:
  • Your child's name, age, or identity
  • Which apps your child uses or how long they use them
  • Device location or GPS data
  • Browsing history or web activity
  • Photos, contacts, messages, or any personal files
  • Audio or video recordings

3. Information Stored Locally on Your Device

The following data is stored only on your device and never transmitted to our servers:

  • Your configured blocking schedules (time windows, days, app lists)
  • Schedule history and activity logs
  • App settings and preferences

4. Device Permissions We Use

  • Usage Access: To detect which app is in the foreground so we can enforce your schedule. Processed entirely on-device, never transmitted.
  • Display Over Other Apps: To show the blocking screen when a restricted app is opened during a schedule.
  • Foreground Service: To keep the monitoring service running while a schedule is active.

5. Subscription and Payment Data

ScrollLok uses Google Play Billing for subscriptions and RevenueCat to manage subscription status. We never handle or store your payment card information. Payment is processed entirely by Google.

  • Google Privacy Policy
  • RevenueCat Privacy Policy

6. Analytics and Crash Reporting

We do not use any third-party analytics or crash reporting tools that collect personal data.

7. Children's Privacy

ScrollLok is designed for parents and guardians to manage their children's device usage. We do not knowingly collect any personal information from children. The App does not include advertising or third-party data collection targeted at children.

8. Data Security

Since all data is stored locally on your device, its security depends on your device's security settings. We recommend using a device PIN or biometric lock to prevent unauthorized access.

9. Data Deletion

Uninstalling the App from your device will permanently delete all locally stored data. There is no account or server-side data to delete.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the App.

11. Contact Us
